current.changeLog: Major Vehicle Characteristics overhaul with mode support, expanded configuration-aware stats, detailed perk/equipment/consumable/directive attribution, improved tooltips and layouts, complete translations, and numerous calculation and display fixes.

previous.changeLog:
Changes
Added compatibility fixes for World of Tanks 2.3.1.3
Updated native carousel patch support for the current Gameface bundle
Improved full-package build automation to detect the active client root automatically
Removed hardcoded 2.3.1.2 dependency assumptions
Improved dependency resolution for Gameface and ModsSettingsAPI
Bumped mod version metadata to 1.0.8

Technical details
The native carousel patch includes the new 2.3.1.3 bundle hash and the updated UI references used by the current game build.

current.changeLog:
- Added individual ModsSettingsAPI checkboxes for all HCC filters.
- Synchronized filter changes between ModsSettingsAPI, the HCC panel, and the vehicle list.
- Keeps multiple active filters combined with AND logic.
- Reworked the filtering-logic, changed filters vehicle-counter-logic and fixed some incorrectly selected DataProvider, more native usage now.
